M-S3b-natural-frozen-brand-union-190rc4-.objective: M9 S3b on 1.9.0rc4 (8abc2c1): S3's objective on a listing above the 250-result window, since Milk now states 246: 18010 Natural & Organic > Frozen (CSV row 10; 279 products in the census of 2026-11-02, the smallest listing above 250 apart from Milk 251 and Specialty Cheeses 255, which may have fallen below as Milk did) read through its brand readings with the M1 identities and the M2 binding. Measured: whether the listing still states more than 250; whether each brand page states its filter (M2); how much of the listing's stated total the brand readings reach; how often a brand reading's page repeats (the union is complete only if no needed page repeats); the brand readings' cost. Known before this stage (O2 2026-11-06; S1b, S4, S5a, S5b and S3 on 1.9.0rc3, 2026-11-09): an unrendered listing answer for ?page=N can carry page 1's products under ranks shifted by 24(N-1), or repeat an earlier page exactly; the collector then ends that listing as incomplete (repeated page). It is intermittent and clustered in time, not tied to a listing: in S4, 8 page-N answers repeated page 1 from 14:33:35Z to 14:36:51Z between distinct ones; in S5a (14:42-14:45Z) the four listings that had repeated in S4 paged, with one repeat (School Office page 4); in S5b (14:51Z) Light Bulbs and School Office repeated again; in S3 (14:57Z) Milk's page 4 repeated an earlier page. S5b's two-lane run on 1.9.0rc3 was rejected by G13: a lane wrote the other lane's page to the database before its answer arrived (6 of 13 listing-page rows); 1.9.0rc4 corrects this.
